verdict.rationale: Jira's own marketing claims it connects engineering, product, and marketing initiatives to coordinate big launches across every team, backed by timeline views and company-level progress visibility. However, nothing in the evidence explicitly documents dependency tracking itself, such as dependency links, blockers, or cross-project dependency visualization. missing for 10: explicit documentation of cross-team dependency linking/visualization, in-depth docs beyond marketing one-liners, independent or hands-on corroboration of launch-coordination use.
